description:
Dear Customer,

The listed price for the product is $149.99. We will apply two discounts to this amount: a 10 % percentage discount and an additional fixed discount of $5.00. After these deductions, the applicable tax rate is 8.25 % (0.0825), which will be added to the net amount to determine the final total.
